svg.title: Quaternion double-cover hemisphere SLERP / 四元数双覆盖半球对齐

g.text: VISUAL LAB / ROUND 17 / S3 DOUBLE-COVER HEMISPHERE FLIP · 19.1° SHORTEST ARC · NO 4DGS CLAIM
Flip into the same hemisphere; stop 340° spin spikes. / 翻转至同号半球，消除 340° 远路甩头。
51 solids · 13/13 checks · aligned arc 20° vs unaligned spin 340°
8192 CPU SLERP queries: closed-form trig 2.80 ms / 32-step geodesic 22.99 ms
R(q)=R(-q) 双覆盖下先将负内积 (-0.984808) 翻转至 +0.984808，避免 α=0.5 处出现 144° 反向错误。
